chunk_id.description: Stable identifier for this chunk: the first 16 hex characters of its content hash plus its index. Re-running on unchanged content produces the same value, so you can upsert instead of re-embedding.

original_id.description: ID of the source item this chunk came from (item id, URL, or a generated index).

source_url.description: URL of the source item, if one was present in the input.

source_field.description: Which field of the source item the text was read from (for example markdown, text, html). Lets you confirm the Actor read the field you meant.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based position of this chunk within its source item.

total_chunks.description: Total number of chunks produced from this source item.

chunk_text.description: Cleaned, structure-aware chunk ready for embedding. Never exceeds max_tokens under the selected encoding. Split code blocks keep their fence and language; split tables repeat their header row.

token_count.description: Exact token count of chunk_text under the selected encoding. Use it to batch embedding requests without re-tokenizing.

token_count_method.description: How token_count was produced: 'tiktoken:<encoding>' for an exact BPE count, or 'estimated:chars' if the tokenizer was unavailable and a conservative character heuristic was used instead.

heading_path.description: Ordered heading hierarchy this chunk sits under, outermost first. Empty for documents without headings.

section.description: heading_path joined with ' > ', for display and metadata filtering.

block_kinds.description: Structural block types present in this chunk: heading, paragraph, list, table, code, quote. Useful for filtering code out of prose retrieval, or vice versa.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of chunk_text. Identical content always hashes identically, so unchanged chunks can be skipped on a re-run.

overlap_tokens.description: How many of this chunk's tokens were carried over from the previous chunk as overlap context. 0 on the first chunk of an item and at every section boundary.

cleaned_at.description: Timestamp when the run that produced this chunk started.
